revision.description: Monotonically increasing; bumped on every write. Lets the portal sync agent detect and merge concurrent local changes.

enabled.description: When true, filter-changing actions additionally require the guardian password (hash lives in /etc/kosher/guardian.shadow, never in this file).

system_whitelist.description: Domains reachable in whitelist mode for every user (OS update host, flatpak remote, connectivity check, portal). Merged with built-in defaults.

guest.description: The guest session: a passwordless kosher-guest account whose home is wiped after every sign-out (GDM PostSession hook).

uid.description: Set by kosherd when the guest account is created.

blocked_categories.description: Category names this user may not reach (see kosherd.categories). Enforced precisely in the proxy for filtered users; for dnsfilter users the resolver blocks the union of categories across all such users, because one resolver cannot answer differently per user.

media_level.description: How much imagery on an allowed page this user may see. Only meaningful in filtered mode: judging a picture means holding it, which means reading the connection.

language_filter.description: Bad language: leave it, substitute a milder word, or block the page. Only enforced in filtered mode, which is the only mode that can read the page.

blocked_categories.description: YouTube category ids this user may not watch.

allowed_channels.description: Channel ids or handles this user may watch. When non-empty, everything else on YouTube is blocked.

custom_profiles.description: The family's own presets, saved from a tuned account. Same fields as a built-in profile; keys start with 'custom-'.

pattern.description: host, host/path, or wildcards: *.host, host/dir/*, host/page*

domain.description: A DNS name, optionally with a leading *. wildcard (matches the domain and all subdomains).

mode.description: none = no internet; whitelist = only whitelisted domains; dnsfilter = family DNS and forced safe search, connection not read; filtered = content filtering (safe search, categories, page rules), which reads the connection on this machine; unfiltered = no filtering. Policies naming the old 'inspect' mode are migrated to 'filtered'.

rules.description: URL allow/block rules, first match wins. Only enforced in inspect mode (paths are encrypted otherwise).

admin.description: Member of kosher-admin. Informational mirror of group membership for the portal; the group is authoritative.

apps.description: Flatpak refs this user may run (enforced via malcontent). Empty = all installed apps.

can_install_apps.description: May this user install apps from the approved catalog through the KosherOS app store? Everything installable is pre-approved by the admin, so this is on by default, including for supervised users.
